name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!

meta.start: Homing Robot OOX-22/FE, Feral Scar Vale

summary: After finding the homing robot OOX-22/FE in Feral Scar Vale, you hear the gnome's voice crackle from it once more. The robot is to be escorted to the Forgotten Coast dock, and afterwards Oglethorpe Obnoticus wants a word with you in Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Safe Place to Take Off
sections.body: The gnome's voice says OOX-22/FE needs somewhere open and safe where a lengthy take-off can begin. The robot has built-in cloaking, but Oglethorpe Obnoticus needs time to make it work again. Oglethorpe suggests the Forgotten Coast dock, long enough for getting everything running, so the robot is to be walked there from where it stands.

sections.title: Afterwards, Booty Bay
sections.body: Once the robot is safely at the dock, Oglethorpe Obnoticus wants you to come and talk in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where does OOX-22/FE need to go?
aliases: where do i take the chicken
faq.answer: The dock along the Forgotten Coast. It is escorted there from Feral Scar Vale, where you found it.
A master inventor whose homing robot series includes OOX-22/FE. Oglethorpe speaks through the robot and is found in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does the robot need to reach the dock?
faq.answer: A lengthy take-off needs an open, safe place, and Oglethorpe says the dock is long enough to get things online. The robot's built-in cloaking needs time before it works again.

aliases: who do i talk to after
faq.answer: Once the robot is safely at the dock, speak to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
